subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘BABY’ is written as ‘43427’ and ‘CREW’ is written as ‘520725’. How will ‘DATE’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘BABY’ is written as ‘43427’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ced35a9718be5fe10873048bc1f52ea38e716cd6d88e3cb92505c488eedff4bc.png] 

‘CREW’ is written as ‘520725’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c935b0311a430388f0c56aaa890fc7662219d84473df92152bb027a65dad219.png] 

Similarly, ‘DATE’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46beb55944d56021b8d7f51d7e5c1a7934a6426189d2b4e2a089140b72d91de8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**63227**".
